objective_pt: Explicar passo a passo como algo funciona ou é feito, com sequenciadores (first, once, after that) e a voz passiva.

teacher.goal_pt: Pedir ao aluno que explique algo simples que ele sabe fazer e observar como ele ordena as etapas.
prompts: How do you make a good cup of coffee?
Can you explain what you do at work to someone outside your field?
watchFor: Inverter a ordem em perguntas indiretas: "Can you explain how does it work?"; o certo é "how it works".
Usar só "and then... and then..."; variar com "once", "after that", "finally".

exercises.prompt: It's easier than it looks. Let me show you how it works.
accepted: It's easier than it looks. Let me show you how it works.
It is easier than it looks. Let me show you how it works.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em pergunta indireta, a ordem é de afirmação: "how it works", sem "does".
commonErrors.correction_en: Let me show you how it works.

options: Could you explain how this machine works?
Could you explain how does this machine work?
Could you explain me how this machine works?
exercises.explanation_pt: Depois de "Could you explain...", a ordem é de afirmação ("how this machine works"), e "explain" não aceita "me" direto.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Você pode me explicar como funciona?"
accepted: Can you explain to me how it works?
Could you explain to me how it works?
Can you explain how it works?
Could you explain how it works?
Can you tell me how it works?
Could you tell me how it works?
Can you show me how it works?
Could you walk me through how it works?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Explain" não aceita a pessoa logo depois: "explain to me". Ou use "tell me".
commonErrors.correction_en: Can you explain to me how it works?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Dentro de outra pergunta, a ordem é de afirmação: "how it works".
commonErrors.correction_en: Can you explain how it works?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Funcionar" no dia a dia é "work": "how it works". "Function" é mais técnico.
commonErrors.correction_en: Can you explain how it works?

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender sequenciadores e verbos de processo: once, beforehand, step, make sure, set up, carry out.
prompts: What's the first step to open a bank account?
What do you need to do beforehand?
watchFor: Usar "after" sozinho como "depois" no começo da frase; preferir "after that" ou "then".
Confundir "make sure" com "be sure" no imperativo.

exercises.example_en: Once the water boils, add the pasta.
Make sure you save the file before closing it.
It only takes five minutes to set up the app.

exercises.instruction_pt: Match each expression to its meaning.
Say it in English: "Assim que você se cadastrar, vai receber um e-mail."
accepted: Once you sign up, you'll receive an email
Once you sign up, you'll get an email
Once you've signed up, you'll receive an email
Once you've signed up, you'll get an email
As soon as you sign up, you'll receive an email
As soon as you sign up, you'll get an email
Once you register, you'll receive an email
As soon as you register, you'll get an email
Once you've registered, you'll receive an email
Once you sign up, you will receive an e-mail

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "once" e "as soon as" usamos o presente, mesmo falando do futuro: "Once you sign up".
commonErrors.correction_en: Once you sign up, you'll receive an email.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Se cadastrar" é "sign up" ou "register". "Cadaster" é um termo técnico de registro de terras.
commonErrors.correction_en: Once you sign up, you'll receive an email.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar a voz passiva na fala rápida ("it's sent", "they're checked") e o "-ed" final.
prompts: Say "the boxes are checked". Do you hear the "t" at the end?
watchFor: Engolir o "-ed" do particípio: "is check" em vez de "is checked".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat. "Checked" and "packed" end with a "t" sound.
exercises.prompt: Every order is checked and packed by hand.
accepted: Every order is checked and packed by hand.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na voz passiva, o verbo vai no particípio: "is checked and packed".
commonErrors.correction_en: Every order is checked and packed by hand.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat. "Delivered" ends with a "d" sound, "collected" has an extra syllable.
exercises.prompt: The parcels are collected in the morning and delivered the next day.
accepted: The parcels are collected in the morning and delivered the next day.

exercises.explanation_pt: Como "collect" termina em "t", o "-ed" vira sílaba: col-LEC-ted.

teacher.goal_pt: Seguir instruções em sequência e responder qual é a próxima etapa.
prompts: What's the next step after you pay online?
What do you have to do beforehand?
watchFor: Perder a ordem das etapas por não perceber "once" e "before".
Responder com o verbo na forma errada depois de "you need to".

exercises.listen: Before you install the update, make sure all your files are backed up.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Before you install... make sure... are backed up": primeiro o backup, depois a atualização.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen and say what you need to do next.
exercises.listen: Okay, you've filled in the form. Once that's done, you need to upload a copy of your ID. What's the next step?
accepted: Upload a copy of my ID
I need to upload a copy of my ID
I have to upload a copy of my ID
The next step is to upload a copy of my ID
Next, I upload a copy of my ID
I need to upload my ID
Upload my ID
To upload a copy of my ID
I upload a copy of my ID

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "need to" o verbo vem na forma base: "I need to upload".
commonErrors.correction_en: I need to upload a copy of my ID.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falando de você mesmo, troque "your" por "my": "upload a copy of my ID".
commonErrors.correction_en: I need to upload a copy of my ID.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen and answer: who checks the applications?
exercises.listen: All applications are reviewed by a committee, and the results are sent out by email a month later.
accepted: A committee
A committee checks them
A committee reviews them
They're reviewed by a committee
They are reviewed by a committee
They're checked by a committee
The committee
The committee reviews them
By a committee

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na voz passiva, quem faz a ação vem depois de "by": "reviewed by a committee".
commonErrors.correction_en: They're reviewed by a committee.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Comissão" (grupo que avalia) aqui é "committee". "Commission" costuma ser a comissão em dinheiro.
commonErrors.correction_en: A committee reviews them.

teacher.goal_pt: Explicar um processo real do trabalho ou da vida (uma receita, um sistema, um trâmite) com etapas claras.
prompts: How does a typical project work at your company, from start to finish?
What's a recipe you know by heart? Talk me through it.
What happens if someone skips a step?
watchFor: Esquecer o verbo "be" na passiva: "the data analyzed".
Usar "you must" demais; variar com "you need to", "you have to", "make sure".

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Os dados são analisados e depois um relatório é enviado ao cliente."
accepted: The data is analyzed and then a report is sent to the client
The data are analyzed and then a report is sent to the client
The data is analysed and then a report is sent to the client
The data is analyzed and after that a report is sent to the client
The data is analyzed, then a report is sent to the client
The data is analyzed and then a report is sent to the customer
The data gets analyzed and then a report is sent to the client

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A voz passiva precisa do verbo "be": "the data is analyzed".
commonErrors.correction_en: The data is analyzed and then a report is sent to the client.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na passiva o verbo vai no particípio: "is sent", não "is send".
commonErrors.correction_en: A report is sent to the client.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Enviamos algo "to" alguém: "sent to the client".
commonErrors.correction_en: A report is sent to the client.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Certifique-se de salvar tudo antes de desligar."
accepted: Make sure you save everything before you turn it off
Make sure you save everything before turning it off
Make sure to save everything before you turn it off
Make sure to save everything before turning it off
Make sure you save everything before shutting down
Make sure you save everything before you shut it down
Be sure to save everything before turning it off
Make sure you save everything before switching it off
Make sure you've saved everything before you turn it off

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Certifique-se" é "make sure". "Certify" é emitir um certificado.
commonErrors.correction_en: Make sure you save everything before you turn it off.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "before", use -ing ("before turning it off") ou uma frase completa ("before you turn it off").
commonErrors.correction_en: Make sure you save everything before turning it off.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Desligar" um aparelho é "turn off", "switch off" ou "shut down". "Disconnect" é desconectar.
commonErrors.correction_en: Make sure you save everything before you turn it off.

accepted: Once the form is approved you will be contacted by email

exercises.instruction_pt: Explain a process you know well, step by step, to someone who has never done it.
exercises.prompt_en: I've never done this before. Could you talk me through it, from the very first step?
guidelines_pt: Use the passive for at least one step: "It's sent...", "It's checked..."

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar sequenciadores, a voz passiva e as perguntas indiretas.
prompts: Can you tell me how your phone's camera works?

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Esse vinho é feito no sul do Brasil."
accepted: This wine is made in the south of Brazil
This wine is made in southern Brazil
This wine is produced in the south of Brazil
This wine is produced in southern Brazil
That wine is made in the south of Brazil

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Produtos são "made": "This wine is made in...". "Done" é usado para tarefas.
commonErrors.correction_en: This wine is made in the south of Brazil.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o "the": "in the south of Brazil". Ou diga "in southern Brazil".
commonErrors.correction_en: This wine is made in the south of Brazil.

exercises.instruction_pt: Complete with the passive form of "send".
exercises.sentence: Your password will be ___ to your phone.
accepted: sent

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "will be" vem o particípio: "will be sent".
commonErrors.correction_en: Your password will be sent to your phone.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which word means "assim que" in a sequence?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Once" no começo da frase é "assim que": "Once it's ready, call me".

exercises.prompt: And that's it. Once you've done it twice, it becomes second nature.
accepted: And that's it. Once you've done it twice, it becomes second nature.
And that is it. Once you have done it twice, it becomes second nature.
